title: a documented status cadence with no scheduler reads as a live capability
body: 2026-07-26: I asked for a 10-min status cadence on the hardening effort. The agent wrote the rule into PLAN.md and created STATUS.md, but armed NO scheduler — so nothing ever fired, and I only found out by asking. The single entry that did exist was also stamped [17:10], copied from earlier CLI output instead of the clock (real commit time 19:00), so the log was both silent AND wrong. This is the same 'documented but not wired' class the hardening review exists to kill (cf. ROLLUP_LANES excluding the daily lane; the reaper logging 160 dry-runs and never reaping). WANTED: either a real scheduler behind any cadence claim, or no claim. A cadence written in a plan file must not read as an armed mechanism. Consider: Anchor could own this - emit the status table itself from live session telemetry on a timer, rather than depending on an agent remembering to.
